source_locators.finding: Example menu W=.2500; recommended quarter-chord core; actual radius=max(ratio*chord,interval width).
Finite regularization for influence from surfaces not containing the lattice control point; whole Biot-Savart integral regularized.
Physical index determines zero core for mutual lattice influences; no explicit sensor override or own-sensor beam-identity rule.
v5.55 introduced induced velocities on sensors; v5.56 same-physical zero-core change explicitly concerns mutual lattice influences.
Sensor is pylon-attached and sees induced flow from all surfaces/volumes; no sensor-core input column.
Near-wingtip sensor sees trailing-vortex velocity; this argues against wholesale own-surface omission but does not identify regularization.
Pylon point and axes move; fixed sensor is obtained at ground anchor; documented speed/beta transform.
K/K selects full versus kinematic-only V/alpha/beta. It is not an Earth/body basis toggle.
Default W=.25 explicitly. Its smaller-spacing wording conflicts with original max rule and its own official appendix; its K summary also conflicts with Drela v5.77 notes.
Official appendix repeats W=.25 recommendation/example and max rule.
Startup reads same-basename .set if present; option values are saved there. Missing archived .set does not prove historical defaults.
Listed change is sideforce/CY/Cl/Cn outputs, not a sensor-core policy. Changelog silence is not proof of implementation identity.
